title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Many Umamusume dream of running in the Japanese Derby. With the main event just a day away, Satono Diamond is more fired up than ever.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I finished preparing my racewear and cleats yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now I can focus purely on today's preparations!
choice_data_list: We'll just be doing some minor adjustments, though.
We'll just be doing some minor adjustments, though.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Right. It's important to make sure my fatigue doesn't carry over to tomorrow, as per your instructions!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It appears that we should have good weather tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the day of Japanese Derby is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's almost time. Hehe! Everything is going smoothly! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond is in a bright mood, and what she says is true. Today is a far cry from the day of the Satsuki Sho, and we arrive at the racecourse without any issues.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I should make a final check on my cleats just in ca—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh no!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's my shoes…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The soles are damaged… They've cracked where I nailed my cleats into them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: They were fine when I checked yesterday…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A quick glance at her shoes tells me that they won't be easy to repair. We've got no other choice but to use her spares.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Luckily, Satono Diamond has already attached cleats to her spare shoes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay! Everything looks good!
choice_data_list: It's a good thing you noticed before the race!
It's a good thing you noticed before the race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's true…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Something out of the ordinary has happened again…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: First, it was the Satsuki Sho, and now it's the Japanese Derby. Why are these things only happening during critical Classic Triple Crown races?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's as if I'm being stopped from realizing the Satono family's dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's like something is actively trying to hold me back…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can't believe how strong the Satono jinx is…
choice_data_list: Dia, right now, you need to focus on—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Even so, I refuse to submit to it! I'll crush every jinx that gets in my way!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I vowed to do so, and I will see my promise through!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll win the Japanese Derby! I swear it!
